name: Demo — WannaCry Global Outbreak
description: Demo scenario inspired by the publicly attributed 2017 WannaCry outbreak. Reconnaissance and propagation context is enriched for matrix coverage, and this is not an authoritative incident reconstruction.

layers.name: DMZ-SERVER
layers.description: Internet-facing server layer for identifying exposed Windows services and vulnerable systems that provide an initial propagation path.

layers.name: INT-ENDPOINT
layers.description: Internal endpoint layer where a reachable host is exploited, the payload executes, and the local environment and files are inspected.

techniques.comment: Initial exploitation on this endpoint is still awaiting direct host-level corroboration.
Registry inspection is marked seen from endpoint telemetry in this demo.

layers.name: INT-NETWORK
layers.description: Internal network layer for discovering adjacent systems and propagating through Windows services and administrative shares.

techniques.comment: Network propagation evidence confirms exploitation of reachable remote services.

layers.name: INT-OPERATIONS
layers.description: Internal business operations layer where data encryption, recovery inhibition, service stoppage, and system disruption create impact.

techniques.comment: System shutdown impact remains unconfirmed for the selected operations layer.
